context_notes: Root cause of G-88-4: feed emits constant SEQUENCE:1, DTSTAMP = CreatedAt, no LAST-MODIFIED, and Events/Quests have no revision column; clients comparing SEQUENCE/DTSTAMP keep stale copies. Server side is fine (ETag = SHA-256 of body). Tests currently PIN the defect (SEQUENCE:1 on both fetches of a rescheduled quest; DTSTAMP == CreatedAt) and must be rewritten deliberately. Write paths to raise the revision: EventsController edit -> UpdateAsync, EventRepository.ApplyTemplateToOccurrencesAsync (series sweep), QuestRepository.FinalizeQuestAsync, quest title edits; consider a Repository-layer SaveChanges hook. Keep unedited entries byte-identical between fetches (ETag/304 and determinism pins).
